description: Gares du réseau ferroviaire géré par la région Bretagne is a dataset listed in data.bretagne.bzh open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Région Bretagne. Points d'arrêts associés aux lignes ferroviaires bretonnes. La donnée contient quelques renseignements sur la localisation et les différents services proposés pour chaque arrêt. Coverage: Brittany. The portal files it under Transport - Mobilité. Its keywords are train express regional, point arret, données ouvertes, données prioritaires, gare, 233500016. The portal shows 136 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2016-07-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence ouverte : https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-bretagne-bzh-portal.
